summary: Proxy Client: servers on localhost, your LAN or a private ad

sections.title: More
items: Proxy Client: servers on localhost, your LAN or a private address now connect directly instead of through the SOCKS proxy, so a local test server can be joined with the proxy on.
Friends List: online friends are listed first, even while a sync is running
Sim: /simboss <phase> typed inside a running F7 boss fight resets the fight and arena but no longer moves you
The dungeon sim skips mob spots a player cannot walk to (walled in behind a lever or outside the room), so Auto Clear no longer stalls on 'no etherwarp path' in rooms like Redstone Crypt.
Sim F7: terminal stands no longer burn, the Arrows device lights only behind solved arrows, clicking a terminal never takes your held item, and Necron's health drops only when you hit him
Breaker Aura: Edit Mode now turns itself off when you change worlds (leaving the dungeon) and after a restart, so picked blocks no longer stay drawn with the aura off.

summary: Co-op sim, Lever Aura and a round of Grim fixes

sections.title: Dungeons
items: Dungeon Sim: real starred mobs at Blood Rush spots and the Watcher blood camp.
Sim blood camp keeps its chunks loaded, so the trips no longer stall.
Sim mini bosses fire their death event, so King Midas clears the room.
Blood Rush: 22 bundled spots outside their room were dropped.
Party Tracker keeps a teammate who left out of the dungeon tab until the run ends.
Friends List shows party friends first under an In Party header.

items.text: AP3: stopwatch nodes wait for an align and fire the tick it ends.
Interactive Map gets Charged Chain and Blink The Chain.
Lever Aura keeps W and sprint through its off-walk turns.
Inventory Walk: new Lag Back Walk setting (off by default).

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fewer anticheat flags while you move: Auto Close Chest and mod chat wait until you stand still.
Profile Viewer lays out its page tabs after the panel width is known.
Co-op sim: a joiner lands at the end of the server tick.

summary: Co-op sim rooms, Carnival and Profile Viewer

sections.title: Dungeons
items: Co-op sim: rooms join through a relay tunnel when the host is unreachable.
Co-op sim: Max Players slider, start portion picker and Move everyone to.
Fast and Auto Leap target pages show one row per leap.
Protect Starred: starred items that are not locked can go into trades.
Profile Viewer: class levels past 50 and a Master Mode divider.

items.text: Breaker Aura: Zero Ping, Legit Multi Break and Burst Multi Break rows.
Blink and Breaker Aura: a paused shot freezes you until the wall is gone.
AP3 Edge Jump jumps on the grounded tick nearer the edge.
Swap To Drill On Pigeon also works on a block-targeted use.

sections.title: More
items: Carnival solvers: Fruit Digging Triggerbot, Prevent Misclicks and Shootout Aim Mode.
Hide Skill XP Text: the Health and Mana Bars switch also strips the skill XP gain.
Crash guard: the game exits cleanly when another mod's thread holds it open.

summary: Co-op sim, Carry Tracker and sound effects

sections.title: Dungeons
items: Carry Tracker: HUD, per-client runs, /carry command and a stop alert.
Reparty: Invite Delay slider and Auto Rejoin.
Boss sim: Spawn Withers switch.
Co-op sim: sim invites, Create, Join and a room list.
Auto Kick uses the floor of the Party Finder listing you joined.

items.text: Lever Aura flips S2 levers beside an AP3 run.
AP3: Wait For Crystal holds a node until End Crystals appear.
Auto Superboom finds tomb blocks with a cached window scan.

sections.title: More
items: Collection Tracker: Only Recent switch and a Recent Window slider.
Mage Beam fades evenly and no longer draws a screen-wide wedge.
Many card blurbs were shortened to fit their cards.

Rare Room, Rare Drop, Duplicate Class, Wither King Statue Box and Dimensional Slash alerts.

Inventory Walk: Hide Keys In Server Menus.

Spotify Lyrics strips video-title tails like Official Audio.

Jungle Pickaxe Alert in the Crystal Hollows.
